scripts.build: npm run build -w @context-deck/core && npm run build -w @context-deck/app && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/desktop dist/extension && cp apps/desktop/index.html apps/desktop/style.css apps/desktop/app.js dist/desktop/ && cp apps/extension/manifest.json apps/extension/background.js dist/extension/
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/app/test/*.test.mjs
